target_tone: Interstellar-adjacent grounded sci-fi — teal shadows, warm amber highlights, quiet gravity

M.description: Historical mathematician figure, late 20s appearance, formal but warm, dark hair

F.description: Young engineer, confident, practical clothes, short hair

Y.description: Viewer surrogate, curious, same age as F, casual ship uniform

world.premise: A deep-space relay crew decodes a repeating signal using mathematics — each chapter is one decoding mission.

sets.name: Control Room
sets.description: Secondary console with cracked display, dish-array status board on back wall, teal shadows

visual_grammar.grade: teal shadows, warm amber highlights, anamorphic flare off screens
camera_rules: hold shots rather than frantic cuts
visual_grammar.screen_direction_rules: M screen-left when facing console; F enters frame right; Y between them in two-shots
